finding: After a forwarded cancellation, an observer-side exception could enter finally and send an additional SIGTERM while the controller is cleaning up. Deferred startup signals also need a single-send guard.
future_use_requirement: Do not reuse this fixed-ID historical observer. For any next observation harness, track cancellation_sent and deliver at most one signal, then wait without a second termination request.
formal_gate_effect: No checker/controller/runtime/source input changed. Assess only genuine actual full terminal/postcheck evidence. Any lost or interrupted result stays incomplete.
